title: Standing on the Steady Rock
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
When I feel small and shaky, weak,
I need a place to stand,
A song says God is my big Rock,
So strong, so safe, so grand.

[Chorus]
Heavenly Father is my Rock,
My safe, high place to stay,
He will not wobble, will not tip,
He holds me up each day.

[Verse 2]
A rock won't wobble, tip, or fall,
It stands there strong and still,
And when I lean on God, my Rock,
He holds me, and He will.

[Chorus]

[Verse 3]
Now close your eyes, and if you feel
All shaky, weak, or small,
Just lean on God, your steady Rock,
He will not let you fall.

[Chorus]
mood: Standing music. A firm, slow, steady pulse like a heartbeat set in stone, unwavering under the voice, matching a story about a Rock that does not wobble or tip. The sway is broad and grounded, more like leaning than rocking. By the last verse it grows lower and slower still, the beat softening into a deep, quiet hold.
